# CloudTrail

Manage regional trail records and look up external SDK management request history.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `cloudtrail` |
| Signing name | `cloudtrail` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2013-11-01` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Trail records / bounded local event history |
| Selected operations | 14 of 60 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#cloudtrail) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Trail logging is records only: no S3 log files, digest delivery, CloudWatch Logs delivery, SNS notification, log validation or KMS encryption.
- Multi-Region and organization trails, shadow trails and IncludeGlobalServiceEvents configuration are unsupported and fail explicitly.
- Event selectors do not execute delivery and data-event collection is not modeled separately; event history describes gateway AWS operations.
- Request parameters and response bodies are always omitted to prevent secrets entering history; sensitive operation error messages use the gateway redaction marker.
- Username is the access key rather than resolved IAM user name; resource enrichment currently includes only S3 bucket route labels.
- History bound is fixed at 1000, not configurable; no CloudTrail Lake, Insights, channels or management console pages.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
